name: api-gateway-mcp-server
description: >- Configures Google Cloud API Gateway to act as a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (Public Preview) that exposes REST APIs as agent tools over HTTP (POST /mcp). Use when migrating OpenAPI 2.0 specs to OpenAPI 3.x for MCP, annotating specs with x-google-api-management.mcp and x-google-mcp-tool, securing tools/list with JWTs or API keys, connecting Google ADK (McpToolset) or Apigee API hub and Agent Registry, or troubleshooting MCP JSON-RPC errors (-32601, -32602, -32000).
